layout.map: Fills the stage above the resource dock. Context panels avoid existing overlays; opening them never pans the camera.
layout.dock: Stable exact die, symbol and remaining budget; widths and height adapt to available resources and decision context.
layout.context: One shared decision tray moves to the regional battle or Fellowship panel. Hover, pin and close preserve uncommitted choices.
layout.regional_route: Compact Fellowship route panel; every neighboring region has a reachable handle. Mass flight uses highlighted regions and the selected endpoint handle.
layout.navigation: Compact map controls with at least 32-point targets; Fellowship and last battle use symbols with tooltips. The decision notice keeps its label and fits beside a pinned card.
layout.tooltips: One read-only Player overlay: 200 ms hover, immediate focus, safe projected text only. Rich previews suppress duplicate hints; pointer gestures, detach and scale changes dismiss them. No input interception or text-field values.
layout.accessibility: Click alternative for every drag; no mandatory number entry or decision scrolling; reduced motion preserves rules and input. Elided portrait labels retain the full safe projection tooltip.

map_contour_coverage.edge_policy: First regionId in ordinal order on an exact shared edge; water and inner rings return no region.
map_contour_coverage.legal_targets: Projected server options; physical polygon contact never authorizes a move.
